what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nicaragua in Costa Rica: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 160398 Nicaraguan asylum seekers in Costa Rica, 59.6% of all asylum seekers from Nicaragua.
Costa Rica is also the largest host of refugees from Nicaragua, followed by the United States, Spain and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Nicaragua, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2004 at 26 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 217125, at the end of 2022 and was lower by the end of 2025.
The data shows large changes from one year to the next between 2017 and 2022.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Costa Rica.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals, and UNHCR adds notes to some of these figures.
